import Mathlib

structure RingBuffer (T : Type) where
  capacity : Nat
  view : List T

def RingBuffer.is_valid {T} (rb : RingBuffer T) : Prop :=
  rb.capacity > 0 ∧ rb.view.length ≤ rb.capacity

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dequeue_precond {T} (rb : RingBuffer T) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  rb.is_valid ∧ rb.view.length > 0
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
-- Returns (value, new_ringbuffer)
def dequeue {T} (rb : RingBuffer T)
    (h_precond : dequeue_precond rb) : T × RingBuffer T :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match h_view : rb.view with
  | [] =>
      False.elim (by
        have h_length : rb.view.length > 0 := h_precond.2
        simpa [h_view] using h_length)
  | x :: xs =>
      (x, { capacity := rb.capacity, view := xs })
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dequeue_postcond {T} (rb : RingBuffer T) (result : T × RingBuffer T)
    (_ : dequeue_precond rb) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (val, new_rb) := result
  new_rb.is_valid ∧
  new_rb.capacity = rb.capacity ∧
  -- Concise & Proof-Free: Old view is (val :: new_view)
  rb.view = val :: new_rb.view
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem dequeue_postcond_satisfied {T} (rb : RingBuffer T)
    (h_precond : dequeue_precond rb) :
    dequeue_postcond rb (dequeue rb h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases rb with
  | mk capacity view =>
      cases view with
      | nil =>
          have h_length : (0 : Nat) < 0 := h_precond.2
          have h_false : False := (Nat.lt_irrefl 0) h_length
          exact h_false.elim
      | cons x xs =>
          change
            RingBuffer.is_valid
                ({ capacity := capacity, view := xs } : RingBuffer T) ∧
              capacity = capacity ∧
              x :: xs = x :: xs
          refine ⟨?_, rfl, rfl⟩
          exact
            ⟨h_precond.1.1,
              Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ xs.length) h_precond.1.2⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
